The design should be clean, aspirant-friendly and professional, and should include: Hero section with a tagline and call-to-action Key features (AI mock tests, current affairs, notes, PYQs, etc.) Testimonials / social proof section Navigation bar and footer Eligibility: Open to all school students, college students, and working professionals with an interest in UI/UX or graphic design No prior professional experience required Team Guidelines: Participation: Individual or teams of up to 5 members Inter-college teams: Allowed Inter-specialization teams: Allowed Each participant can be part of only one team Competition Format: Number of problem statements: 1 Number of rounds: 2 (Design Submission) Duration: 7 days from the start date Submission: share a website url to view design Rules: The design must be 100% original. Plagiarism or copied templates will lead to disqualification. Submit before the deadline. Late entries will not be accepted. Only one submission per team. Do not include offensive, political, or copyrighted content. UPSC ZONE AI reserves the right to use winning designs for showcase and promotional purposes, with credit to the designer. The decision of the judges will be final and binding. Judging Criteria: Creativity and originality UI/UX and ease of navigation Visual appeal (colors, typography, layout) Relevance to the UPSC aspirant audience Responsiveness and attention to detail Rewards & Recognition: E-Certificate of Victory for the winner(s) Certificate of Participation for all valid submissions Winning designs featured on UPSC ZONE AI's website

raw.details:
Overview:

Design a modern, engaging home page for UPSC ZONE AI, an AI-powered platform for UPSC and competitive exam aspirants. Show your UI/UX skills and win certificates and recognition!

Problem Statement:

Design the home page (landing page) of UPSC ZONE AI for web (desktop) and, optionally, mobile. The design should be clean, aspirant-friendly and professional, and should include:

  • Hero section with a tagline and call-to-action
  • Key features (AI mock tests, current affairs, notes, PYQs, etc.)
  • Testimonials / social proof section
  • Navigation bar and footer

Eligibility:

  • Open to all school students, college students, and working professionals with an interest in UI/UX or graphic design
  • No prior professional experience required

Team Guidelines:

  • Participation: Individual or teams of up to 5 members
  • Inter-college teams: Allowed
  • Inter-specialization teams: Allowed
  • Each participant can be part of only one team

Competition Format:

  • Number of problem statements: 1
  • Number of rounds: 2 (Design Submission)
  • Duration: 7 days from the start date
  • Submission: share a website url to view design

Rules:

  • The design must be 100% original. Plagiarism or copied templates will lead to disqualification.
  • Submit before the deadline. Late entries will not be accepted.
  • Only one submission per team.
  • Do not include offensive, political, or copyrighted content.
  • UPSC ZONE AI reserves the right to use winning designs for showcase and promotional purposes, with credit to the designer.
  • The decision of the judges will be final and binding.

Judging Criteria:

  • Creativity and originality
  • UI/UX and ease of navigation
  • Visual appeal (colors, typography, layout)
  • Relevance to the UPSC aspirant audience
  • Responsiveness and attention to detail

Rewards & Recognition:

  • E-Certificate of Victory for the winner(s)
  • Certificate of Participation for all valid submissions
  • Winning designs featured on UPSC ZONE AI's website
